# Creating Columns

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Creating Columns

In a grid layout, elements are positioned using rows and columns.

You can define the total number of columns with their widths using the grid-template-columns property.

Consider the code below:

```html
1<div class="container">
2    <div class="item-1"></div>
3    <div class="item-2"></div>
4    <div class="item-3"></div>
5<div>
```

```css
1.container {
2    /* Customize column sizes */
3    grid-template-columns: 200px 100px 50px;
4    height: 150px;
5
6    display: grid;
7}
8
9.item-1 { background-color: orange; }
10.item-2 { background-color: lightblue; }
11.item-3 { background-color: pink; }
```

Browser Output

![Customize Column Sizes](data:image/png;base64,)

Notice the following CSS rule inside the container selector:

```css
/* Customize column sizes */
grid-template-columns: 200px 100px 50px;
```

Because we have defined three different width values (200px, 100px, and 50px), the grid will now contain three columns.

You can change the values of grid-template-columns to change the size of each column easily.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)
